#!/bin/sh
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   -J ideal_fire
#   -N 1
#   -n 1
#   -t 00:10:00
#   -o/-e ideal_fire.eo%j

#flux: --job-name=ideal_fire
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=10m

# Omitted Slurm options: -o/-e with %j token
# Slurm's %j token (job id) is not portable in Flux output/error directives.
# Performance implication: none, but logs may overwrite/collide unless you choose unique filenames.

ulimit -c 0
ulimit -s unlimited
set -e
hostname

. ~rodierq/DEV_57/MNH-PHYEX070-b95d84d7/conf/profile_mesonh-LXifort-R8I4-MNH-V5-6-2-ECRAD140-MPIAUTO-O2

set -x

ls -lrt

rm -f FIRE_LES.??? FIRE_PGD.???

# Replace mpirun wrapper with flux-run for launching 1 rank.
time flux run -n 1 -c 1 PREP_IDEAL_CASE${XYZ}

mv OUTPUT_LISTING1 OUTPUT_LISTING1_ideal

touch FIRE_PGD.des
ls -lrt

rm -f file_for_xtransfer pipe_name
ls -lrt

# Original script submits another Slurm job: `sbatch run_mesonh`
# Flux has no portable equivalent for submitting Slurm jobs from within a Flux batch script.
# Performance implication: downstream job will not be scheduled automatically; pipeline orchestration must be done externally or adapted to Flux.

#!/bin/sh
#SBATCH -J ideal_fire
#SBATCH -N 1            # nodes number (=NBP)
#SBATCH -n 1            # CPUs number (on all nodes) (=NBP*TPN)
#SBATCH -o ideal_fire.eo%j   #
#SBATCH -e ideal_fire.eo%j   #
#SBATCH -t 00:10:00    # time limit

# Echo des commandes
ulimit -c 0
ulimit -s unlimited
# Arrete du job des la premiere erreur
set -e
# Nom de la machine
hostname 

. ~rodierq/DEV_57/MNH-PHYEX070-b95d84d7/conf/profile_mesonh-LXifort-R8I4-MNH-V5-6-2-ECRAD140-MPIAUTO-O2

export MPIRUN="Mpirun -np 1"

set -x
set -e


ls -lrt

rm -f FIRE_LES.??? FIRE_PGD.???
time ${MPIRUN} PREP_IDEAL_CASE${XYZ}
mv OUTPUT_LISTING1  OUTPUT_LISTING1_ideal
 
touch FIRE_PGD.des
ls -lrt 

rm -f file_for_xtransfer pipe_name

ls -lrt 

sbatch run_mesonh
ja
